subject.title: fix(skills): apply command description limits per channel

question: Should this PR require current-head live Discord or Mattermost registration proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gate for this narrow transport-boundary fix?
rationale: The code review supports the implementation, but ClawSweeper's external-PR proof gate does not treat tests, CI, Testbox, or prepare-run as real behavior proof for an external API registration path.

options.title: Require live registration proof
options.body: Ask for redacted current-head terminal output or logs showing Discord or Mattermost command registration accepting the bounded descriptions.

options.title: Apply proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the source/API-contract evidence and mark proof overridden before normal merge gates proceed.

recommendation.title: Require live registration proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted current-head terminal output or logs showing Discord or Mattermost command registration accepting the bounded descriptions.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent posted the land-ready proof comment and is already assigned on this proof/readiness question.
